caption:
Figure 2. Overview of our proposed framework GenNBV. Our end-to-end policy takes the historical multi-source observations as input,
transforms them into a more informative scene representation, and produces the next viewpoint position. A reward signal will be returned
at training time to optimize the end-to-end policy for maximizing the expected cumulative reward in one episode. Specifically, the signal
is the increased coverage ratio after collecting a new viewpoint.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed full final and initial draft; read caption and independent pair checks. The complete original source preserves both numeric observation poses, coordinate axes, history, semantic/geometric representations, vectorization, policy action feedback, and coverage comparison. New title and training-reward footer match caption exactly in meaning; no new coverage encoding or pose interpretation. Complete original rectangle independently replayed native before acceptance.
